description: This file contains tests for the 'last-modified' functionality in a Git environment, using shell scripting to set up, execute, and verify various scenarios related to tracking last modifications of files and directories with git commands.

methods.name: check_last_modified
methods.description: A shell function that executes the 'git last-modified' command with specified options and compares its output against expected results, used to verify the correctness of last modification tracking.
